content:
Matt: Quick heads-up — trying to land PR #18642 (db connection pool fix + small migration) before the deploy freeze today. Need 2 reviewers + green CI.
Jason: I'll take a look now, running local e2e. ETA ~30m.
Priya: Can also review the migration change. @Matt did you run the migration smoke on staging?
Matt: ran smoke on staging, looked fine. CI is currently queued on mac/e2e though. linux matrix passed.
ci-bot: CI pipeline for PR #18642: linux/unit ✓, linux/integration ✓, mac/e2e ⏳ (queued on runner-7), docker-build ✓.
Anna: Heads up — rebase window closes 17:45 UTC, deploy freeze at 18:00 UTC. If this needs a rebase after 17:45 we'll need to move it to tomorrow or file an exception.
release-coordinator: Rebase window = 17:45 UTC. If you can't merge by that time, open a pre-freeze exception in the release board and ping me.
Matt: ok. I have a fast rebase ready if CI flakes. Rebase steps I run are:
```
$ git fetch origin
$ git checkout pr/18642
$ git rebase origin/main
$ git push --force-with-lease
```
Priya: small note — I left a comment about migration id collisions. If you change it I'll re-run the local migration quickly.
Matt: addressed comment, pushed update. @Jason any blockers on your review?
Jason: left 1 nit but it's optional. Will approve once CI is green :thumbsup:
DevOps: FYI — if you land close to freeze we can route 10% traffic to the dedicated pool via canary toggle, but that requires adding the toggle to the canary config and a short rollout window. Not blocking the merge, just a mitigation.
Matt: thanks — if the mac runner stalls at ~15m left I'll request the exception immediately. Otherwise aiming to land at ~17:30 UTC.
ci-bot: mac/e2e started on runner-7; estimated remaining time ~22m.
Anna: 👍 keeping eyes on this thread. If anything looks stalled ping me directly.
Jason: approved.
Priya: approved.
Matt: landed at 17:48 UTC after filing a pre-freeze exception (release-coordinator approved). Will monitor logs for 30m.
release-coordinator: Exception recorded: RL-4892 — landed PR #18642 post-rebase-window with approval. Please post a short follow-up status in 30m.
DevOps: Monitoring tip — watch connection pool metrics (conn_wait, max_conn) and p99 latency. If anything spikes roll back using the canary toggle.
Matt: will report back in 30m. Thanks everyone :tada:
